We welcome contributions to `SCpubr`!

## How to contribute

1. **Report bugs**: Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/enblacar/SCpubr/issues)
2. **Request features**: Suggest new functions or improvements
3. **Submit pull requests**: Contribute code improvements

## Code of conduct

Please be respectful and constructive in all interactions.

## Contact

For questions or suggestions: `scpubr@gmail.com`
